## Purpose

Our summit builds on one of the initial goals of R/Pharma - to bring people together in a room and start the conversations.  The first two years of R/Pharma were solely in-person events where amazing work was discussed, sparking industry initiatives.  When we moved to online conferences, the benefit of face-to-face interaction was lost.  The R/Pharma Summit brings it back.

Our face-to-face summits bring thought leaders and decision makers together to discuss all things open source and Pharma. The US summit takes place alongside posit::conf. In 2026, we also held our inaugural EU summit at Novartis in Basel, Switzerland, on October 5, alongside BioTechX. The notes taken, and any actions, are shared with the community.

### {{< fa users >}} 2026 F2F Roundtables in Basel (EU Summit)

The inaugural R/Pharma EU Summit took place at Novartis in Basel, Switzerland, on October 5, 2026, alongside BioTechX. Participants discussed the following five round-table topics:

- [Trust and Safeguards for Agentic Workflows](/docs/summit/posts/2026-eu-agentic-safeguards.html)
- [Open Source in Filings: R Validation in 2026](/docs/summit/posts/2026-eu-open-source-submissions.html)
- [Validation of Data Exploration Apps](/docs/summit/posts/2026-eu-app-validation.html)
- [Does renv Make Sense in an SCE?](/docs/summit/posts/2026-eu-renv-sce.html)
- [Rule-Based vs AI-Driven Automation](/docs/summit/posts/2026-eu-automation.html)

:::
:::

### {{< fa users >}} 2026 F2F Roundtables in Houston (United States)

90+ leaders met F2F in Houston (September 13th) for a series of
discussions on the most pressing topics for use of AI, environment reproducibility, use of open source in regulatory submissions, and more. 

The discussion was crowdsourced via a github discussion, and led to the 
following topics:

- [Trust, Safeguards & Governance for Agentic AI](/docs/summit/posts/2026-ai-trust-governance.html)
- [AI in Practice: Automation, Cost & Skills](/docs/summit/posts/2026-ai-practice.html)
- [Reproducible Environments & Package Provisioning](/docs/summit/posts/2026-env-packages.html)
- [Open Source in Regulatory Submissions & Validation](/docs/summit/posts/2026-open-source-submissions.html)
- [The Future of Analysis Results Standards (ARD/ARS)](/docs/summit/posts/2026-future-ard.html)
- [Driving Adoption Beyond the Early Adopters](/docs/summit/posts/2026-driving-adoption.html)

:::
:::

- [SCEs in 2025](/docs/summit/posts/2025-sce.html)

### {{< fa users >}} 2023 F2F Roundtables in Chicago
